daytype.eia_preprint_overextension_gate limb (b) reads, in prose, 'INCOHERENT D-1 flow - session_b_share vs big_print_b_share DISAGREE'. Its parsed conditions[] rows are 'd1_session_b_share_side >= 0.5' and 'd1_big_print_b_share_side >= 0.5' - two independent SIDE tests. A side test is not a disagreement test, and conditions_state is marked 'parsed', so anything consuming the machine-readable conditions gets different semantics from anything reading the prose. Today the two happen to agree (0.437 and 0.466, both below 0.5, coherent), so the divergence is invisible on my day - which is precisely why it should be fixed before a day where it is not.

selector.divergence_resolution carries the condition tape_conditions.session_b_share >= 0.50. tape_conditions.b_share_basis_note states directly: 'An ABSOLUTE 0.50 bar is only meaningful on the two-sided series; bars fitted empirically on the original series must keep reading the original series.' 0.50 is a physics bar (a 50/50 tape), not an empirically fitted one, so by the state's own rule it belongs on session_b_share_two_sided. Today the two series straddle the bar - 0.437 original, 0.503 two-sided - so the limb reads FALSE on the named path and TRUE on the correct one. This is a live sign-flipping ambiguity on a selector limb, not a theoretical one. It should be audited across every play carrying an absolute 0.50 b_share bar.

flow_calendar serves bcom_ng_roll_this_month true and gsci_ng_roll_this_month true, while bcom_roll_day_n and gsci_roll_day_n are both null. flow.resting_program_inverts_aggressor_tilt keys its two primary conditions on exactly those two null fields (bcom_roll_day_n >= 1, gsci_roll_day_n >= 1), so the play is silently unevaluable in any month flagged as a roll month - which is the only month it could ever fire in. Both roll windows are deterministic public calendar (GSCI and BCOM both run fixed business-day windows) and business_day_of_month is already served (18), so the counters are computable. Today it does not matter because bd 18 is past both windows, but the play is structurally disabled.

weather.summer_burn_lane_exclusion requires a per-BA weekly RISE COUNT in gas_share. The state serves per-BA gas_share as a LEVEL only, and serves a weekly change in absolute MWh (gas_chg_7d_mwh) for US48 alone. Computing share change needs the prior week's demand denominator per BA, which is not served. The breadth count is therefore not computable as specified. Either serve gas_share_chg_7d_mwh per BA, or restate the play on the MWh basis and re-measure its thresholds on that basis.
